# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to tapping mode (PhaseContrast) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 s per line (51.2s total / 128 lines)
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Points: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: PhaseContrast (tapping mode)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(5)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("\nScanning finished!")

# Get the gallery history path to find the saved file
try:
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryPath()
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
except:
    print("Could not get gallery path directly")

del spm

import nanosurf
import time

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to PhaseContrast (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast
print(f"Operating mode set to: {opmode.OperatingMode}")

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s total / 128 lines)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Image size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm")
print(f"  Points: {scan.Points}")
print(f"  Lines: {scan.Lines}")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines} s")

# Set filename prefix
file_name = "afm_10x10um_scan_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)
print(f"Filename prefix set to: {file_name}")

# Start scan (from bottom to top)
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("\nScanning finished!")

# Get the saved file path

try:

    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")

import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get all necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode
zcontrol = application.ZController
head = application.ScanHead

# Set operating mode to PhaseContrast (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.PhaseContrast

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame
scan.Scantime = 0.4  # 0.4 seconds per line (51.2s total / 128 lines)

# Set a filename prefix
file_name = "afm_10x10um_scan_"
application.SetGalleryHistoryFilenameMask(file_name)

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6:.1f} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6:.1f} µm")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Time per line: {scan.Scantime} s")
print(f"  Total scan time: {scan.Scantime * scan.Lines:.1f} s")
print(f"  Operating mode: PhaseContrast (tapping mode)")

# Start scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining_lines = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining_lines}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("\nScanning finished!")

# Get the gallery history path to find the saved file
try:
    gallery_path = application.GalleryHistoryPath
    print(f"Gallery path: {gallery_path}")
    
    # List files in the gallery directory to find the most recent .nid file
    if os.path.exists(gallery_path):
        files = [f for f in os.listdir(gallery_path) if f.endswith('.nid')]
        if files:
            # Sort by modification time to get the most recent
            files.sort(key=lambda x: os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(gallery_path, x)), reverse=true)
            latest_file = files[0]
            full_path = os.path.join(gallery_path, latest_file)
            print(f"\nImage saved at: {full_path}")
        else:
            print("No .nid files found in gallery path")
    else:
        print(f"Gallery path does not exist: {gallery_path}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting gallery path: {e}")

del spm
